what: The plan adds SECURITY.md text and tests claiming defensive HEAD-validation failures reset the worktree to baseline, but it does not update the defensive fail_status paths to perform that reset.
scenario_or_breakage: Detached HEAD, non-ancestor, merge-commit, or multi-commit advancement currently exits via fail_status without calling reset_head_to_baseline, leaving the repository on the external fixer-created HEAD while the proposed docs/tests assert reset-to-baseline behavior.
suggested_fix: Either add the minimal lint-fix-loop.sh change to reset to baseline before these head-changed-after-dispatch exits, or narrow the SECURITY.md/test assertions to the actual fail-closed-without-reset contract.
